name: Scope Intelligence
runtime_tests: Click one card and ask: Make this card title shorter. Verify only that card changes.
Select a section and ask: Make only this section more compact. Verify no sibling sections change.
Ask: Make all headings slightly smaller. Verify global typography tokens change.
Ask: Make all cards less rounded. Verify global card radius token changes instead of per-Spark overrides.
Ask: Increase spacing on all sections. Verify global section-layout token changes.
Ask: Make this image less rounded. Verify only the selected image/section context changes.
Create a pending local request, then Proceed. Verify stored original scope is retained.
